name: Blood Hunter
tooltip:
Blood Hunter
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
Blood red with scales angled for speed and brutality. A creature built on the thrill of the hunt so much so that its spirit has been known to hunt the very Anglers that reel it from the waters of Zul'Aman. A gloriously dangerous reminder to keep your wits about you.

Special:

Blood Hunter Spirit

Catching a Blood Hunter has a chance for their spirit to come back for revenge. Fight off the spirit for bonus loot! Luring Blood Hunters increases this chance.

This is also a commonly used fish for Midnight Cooking Feasts.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Zul'Aman
- Voidstorm

Fishing Pools:
- Surface Ripple
- Hunter Surge

Rates:
- This fish is mostly found in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
